fullTextZH: 现在很多很多人喜欢看动画，
fullTextEN: Nowadays, many, many people like watching animation,
Many, many people are learning Japanese,
But I don't like watching animation.

fullTextZH: 有一个动画是真人动画，
fullTextEN: There is an animation that is live-action animation,

fullTextZH: 有一部分的东西是真的，
fullTextEN: Some parts of it are real,

fullTextZH: 有一部分的东西是假的。
fullTextEN: Some parts of it are fake.

fullTextZH: OK这只熊有很多很多特点，
fullTextEN: Okay, this bear has many, many features,
This bear has clothes and a hat.
This bear can speak two languages,
This bear, its English is very good!

fullTextZH: 很好！它的英语很有礼貌，
fullTextEN: Very good! Its English is very polite,
This bear speaks very good English,

fullTextZH: 它是一只很有礼貌的熊，
fullTextEN: It is a very polite bear,
This bear likes to eat sandwiches,
Oh~ he loves to eat marmalade.

fullTextZH: 因为他很喜欢吃三明治，
fullTextEN: Because he really likes to eat sandwiches,
Hmm~ but he really likes it,

fullTextZH: 嗯~这个名字是英国的一个地方，
fullTextEN: Hmm~ this name is a place in England,

fullTextZH: 也是澳大利亚的一个地方，
fullTextEN: It's also a place in Australia,

fullTextZH: 这只熊觉得它的名字太长了！
fullTextEN: This bear thinks its name is too long!

fullTextZH: 我也觉得它的名字太长了。
fullTextEN: I also think its name is too long.

fullTextZH: 好，所以这只熊是一只棕色的熊，
fullTextEN: Okay, so this bear is a brown bear,

fullTextZH: 它是一只会说英语的熊，
fullTextEN: It is a bear that can speak English,
But this bear has no money,
He used to live in Peru,

fullTextZH: 你知道这只熊是什么吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what this bear is?

fullTextZH: 在中文我们说它是帕丁顿熊，
fullTextEN: In Chinese, we say it is Paddington Bear,
Do you like watching Paddington Bear?

fullTextZH: 可是我很喜欢很喜欢帕丁顿熊！
fullTextEN: but I really, really like Paddington Bear!
Hmm~ I think it's very cute!
I really, really want to go to the UK,
What about you? What bear do you like?
